items.title: Flats and houses
items.body: Walls, ceilings and doors. We remove gotelé texture, repair cracks and finish with two coats.

items.title: Apartment buildings
items.body: Stairwells, lobbies and dados without blocking anyone's way. A clear quote for the residents' meeting.

items.title: Façades
items.body: Façade, balcony and light-well restoration and painting, from scaffolding or rope access.

items.title: Shops and offices
items.body: We paint at night or over the weekend so you don't close for a single day.

items.title: Big builds
items.body: Support for contractors on new builds, refurbishments and large venues.

items.title: Special finishes
items.body: Lacquered doors, enamelled railings and grilles, damp treatments.

obrelier.title: You always know who's on your job.
obrelier.body: Every painter clocks in on arrival, verified on site. At the end of the day the report comes to you: what got done, by whom and how many hours. The hours you pay for are the hours that happened.
obrelier.why: We use it on every job, from a 40 m² flat to Camp Nou. For us it's control; for you, peace of mind.

process.title: How we work.
process.intro: No surprises: you know what happens each day, and why.

steps.title: Visit and measure
steps.body: We come round, measure up and check the state of walls and ceilings. Free of charge.

steps.title: Fixed quote
steps.body: Itemised, with materials and brands. What you sign is what you pay.

steps.title: Protection
steps.body: Floors, furniture and sockets covered. Tape on every edge.

steps.title: Painting
steps.body: Repairs, primer and two coats. Daily report in Obrelier.

steps.title: Snagging and clean-up
steps.body: We check it with you under raking light. Anything not right gets fixed before we leave.

items.quote: They took the gotelé off the whole flat and we didn't find a speck of dust in the wardrobes.
The residents' meeting approved the quote in one go: itemised, no surprises.
They painted the shop in two nights. On Monday we opened as if nothing had happened.

faq.title: The usual questions.
faq.more: Anything else? Message us on WhatsApp and we'll reply the same day.

items.q: How much does it cost to paint a flat in Barcelona?
items.a: It depends on the size, the state of the walls and whether gotelé needs removing. After the visit you get a fixed written price within 48 hours, broken down room by room.

items.q: Do I need to empty the flat?
items.a: No. We move and cover the furniture ourselves. We only ask you to put away anything fragile or valuable.

items.q: How long does a flat take?
items.a: An average flat takes 3 to 5 working days. The exact schedule is in the quote and you follow it daily in the Obrelier report.

items.q: Do you work for apartment buildings?
items.a: Yes. We prepare the quote for the residents' meeting, put up notices for neighbours and always keep the way clear.

items.q: What is Obrelier and why do you use it?
items.a: It's the app our crews use to clock in on every job. That way we know, and you know, who worked, when, and what got done, without calls or paperwork.
